fields.name: pupil_ref
fields.hint: the pupil reference code, verbatim. It is a code, never a name — this corpus contains no names

fields.name: pupil_age
fields.hint: the pupil's age in whole years, as the plan states it. When the plan says the age is not stated, return null -- do not estimate it, do not infer it from anything else on the plan, and do not copy the words

fields.name: plan_status
fields.hint: is this plan still a draft, or is it already in effect?

fields.name: present_levels
fields.hint: rule C-1. The state of the Present Levels of Performance section: absent if there is no such section or its body is a placeholder; present_not_measurable if it is there and is missing one of C-1's elements; present_complete otherwise

fields.name: annual_goals
fields.hint: rule C-2. The state of the Annual Goals section. present_not_measurable if ANY goal in it is missing a baseline, a criterion or a measurement method, or states one in words carrying no quantity. One unmeasurable goal makes the whole component unmeasurable -- the section is never scored on average

fields.name: progress_measurement
fields.hint: rule C-3. The state of the Progress Measurement and Reporting section. present_not_measurable if it names a method and no reporting frequency, or gives a frequency that is not one ('regularly', 'as needed', 'periodically')

fields.name: services
fields.hint: rule C-4. The state of the Services section. present_not_measurable if ANY service line is missing its frequency, its duration or its location

fields.name: accommodations
fields.hint: rule C-5. The state of the Accommodations section. present_not_measurable if an accommodation is named with no setting, or the section is a general permission ('as needed', 'teacher discretion')

fields.name: participation_rationale
fields.hint: rule C-6. The state of the Participation with Peers section. present_not_measurable if it states an intention with no extent, or an extent with no reason

fields.name: transition
fields.hint: rule C-7, the CONDITIONAL one. Answer 'not_required' when the plan STATES the pupil's age and it is BELOW the rulebook's transition age -- whatever the plan does or does not contain. Otherwise describe the document: absent, present_not_measurable or present_complete. When the plan does NOT state an age, never answer not_required -- an unknown requirement is not an absent one

fields.name: checklist_claim
fields.hint: what the Checklist Completed By section CLAIMS a previous reviewer found, copied as stated. It is a field to report and it is NEVER an input to any component state or to the outcome

fields.name: case_manager_note
fields.hint: the case manager's own free-text remark on the plan, copied verbatim

fields.name: plan_outcome
fields.hint: the outcome the seven component states and the pupil's age produce under the shipped rulebook. Work through the four checks IN ORDER, stopping at the first that fires. (1) Any REQUIRED component 'absent' -> components_missing. (2) Any REQUIRED component 'present_not_measurable' -> not_measurable. (3) The plan does not state the pupil's age AND transition is anything other than present_complete -> undetermined. (4) Otherwise -> complete. A component whose state is 'not_required' is judged on nothing. Never decide this from the checklist's claim and never from the case manager's note
